description: Generated by scripts/contracts/generate.mjs from schemas/examples/metamodel/standard-model.yaml. Do not edit.
text:
# Standard model (D-037, extended by D-059 and D-060), shipped with LogReq and written by workspace.init (SR-014).
# Keys never change (D-043); names are English (D-019). Every built-in meaning has a key (SR-014 AK3):
# each type and property meaning exactly one, derivation and replacement two relation kinds each
# (open question #150).
# Marked "assumption": not yet covered by a decision.
logreq-metamodel: 1

types:
  - key: need
    name: Need
    prefix: N
    meaning: need
    properties: [title, rationale, topic]
    required: [title]
  - key: use-case
    name: Use Case
    prefix: UC
    properties: [title, rationale]
    required: [title]
  - key: system-requirement
    name: System Requirement
    prefix: SR
    meaning: requirement
    properties:
      [
        title,
        rationale,
        requirement-type,
        acceptance-criteria,
        validity,
        packages,
        emergent,
        verification-method,
        statement,
        source,
        source-identifier,
        import-date,
        delivery,
        topic,
      ]
    required: [title, requirement-type, acceptance-criteria]
  - key: decision
    name: Decision
    prefix: D
    properties: [title, rationale]
    required: [title]
  - key: variant
    name: Variant
    prefix: VAR
    meaning: variant
    properties: [title]
    required: [title]
  - key: package
    name: Package
    prefix: PKG
    meaning: package
    properties: [title]
    required: [title]

properties:
  - key: title
    name: Title
    kind: text
    meaning: title
  - key: rationale
    name: Rationale
    kind: text
  - key: requirement-type
    name: Requirement Type
    kind: choice
    content: true
    choices:
      - { key: functional, name: Functional }
      - { key: quality, name: Quality }
      - { key: performance, name: Performance }
      - { key: interface, name: Interface }
      - { key: constraint, name: Constraint }
  - key: acceptance-criteria
    name: Acceptance Criteria
    kind: text
    many: true
    content: true
  - key: validity
    name: Validity
    kind: relation
    many: true
    target-types: [variant]
    content: true
    meaning: validity
  - key: packages
    name: Package
    kind: relation
    many: true
    target-types: [package]
    meaning: packages
  - key: emergent
    name: Emergent
    kind: choice
    content: true
    meaning: emergent
    choices:
      - { key: "yes", name: "Yes" }
      - { key: "no", name: "No" }
  - key: verification-method
    name: Verification Method
    kind: choice
    content: true
    meaning: verification-method
    choices:
      - { key: test, name: Test }
      - { key: analysis, name: Analysis }
      - { key: inspection, name: Inspection }
      - { key: demonstration, name: Demonstration }
  - { key: statement, name: Statement, kind: text, meaning: statement }
  - { key: source, name: Source, kind: text, meaning: source }
  - { key: source-identifier, name: Source Identifier, kind: text, meaning: source-identifier }
  - { key: import-date, name: Import Date, kind: date, meaning: import-date }
  - { key: delivery, name: Delivery, kind: text, meaning: delivery }
  # D-060 names only the property. Marked "assumption": kind text (the topics belong to the
  # project, D-019), on need and system-requirement as this spec uses "thema", not content
  # (like rationale and packages, D-057), not required.
  - { key: topic, name: Topic, kind: text }

relations:
  - key: refines
    name: Refines
    inverse-name: Refined by
    meaning: derivation
  - key: derives-from
    name: Derives from
    inverse-name: Derived by
    source-types: [system-requirement]
    target-types: [need, use-case, system-requirement]
    meaning: derivation
  - key: based-on
    name: Based on
    inverse-name: Basis for
    target-types: [decision]
  - key: supersedes # replacement by a successor, D-045 / SR-072
    name: Supersedes
    inverse-name: Superseded by
    meaning: replacement
  - key: replaces
    name: Replaces
    inverse-name: Replaced by
    source-types: [system-requirement]
    target-types: [system-requirement]
    meaning: replacement
  - key: excludes # D-059, SR-042
    name: Excludes
    inverse-name: Excluded by
    source-types: [variant]
    target-types: [system-requirement]
    meaning: exclusion

statuses:
  - { key: draft, name: Draft, initial: true }
  - { key: approved, name: Approved }
  - { key: obsolete, name: Obsolete, invalid: true }
